protocol.fixed_training: Original pretrained RuBERT-tiny2; 3 epochs, last checkpoint; only train split.
protocol.limitation: Internal holdout from provisional automatic labels, not independent manual gold; not comparable with diagnostic119 F1.

grouping.limitation: No known exact/TF-IDF edges cross splits; not a guarantee against all semantic/template leakage.

tokenization.normalization: NFKC; collapse whitespace; preserve case and ё
tokenization.pooling: mean over all attention-masked tokens of real windows, including special tokens
tokenization.padding: longest real window in document batch

training.loss: BCEWithLogitsLoss; unweighted mean over documents and classes

training.evaluation: No validation/holdout/test; all supplied training rows used in all epochs

search.global: Точный перебор уникальных score; равные score переключаются атомарно
search.tie_preference: Исходный порог, затем 0.5, близость к 0.5, больший порог

per_category.objective: Общий micro-F1, не среднее по категориям
per_category.acceptance: Только строгое улучшение, точное сравнение дробей

search.zero_positive_policy: Без отдельной настройки; сохранён global (в fixed — 0.5)

calibration.selection_data: validation only; no control or public test scores/labels used

inference.latency_scope: Actual calibrated run(), sequential documents; excludes loading; warmed by probability collection.
